parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating metal cover of the USB flash drive, made of stainless steel, which protects the USB connector when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a protective swivel cover that rotates around the base body to shield or expose the USB connector.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around a pivot point, typically up to 180 degrees, allowing the user to open or close the USB connector.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, made of ABS plastic, housing the internal memory chip and USB connector.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, contains the electronic components, and serves as the main gripping area for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it acts as the fixed base for the rotating cover.
